📊 The biggest party in each metro, from the first metro councils in 2000 to today.

Metros where one party won more than half the seats:
2000: 5 of 6
2006: 5 of 6
2011: all 8
2016: 4 of 8
2021: 3 of 8
2026: 1 of 8 (Cape Town)

From 2011 to 2026, our big cities went from single-party councils to coalitions. Seven of the eight metros are now hung, so coalition deals will decide who sets your rates, water and electricity tariffs.

Note: the chart shows the biggest party in each council, which is not always the party that governs. Buffalo City and Mangaung became metros in 2011.

Source: IEC results 2000-2026.
